_doc: Another Breath, Long Stride and Quick Breath come from story beats and gear only; Hard Landing (the Warden's shove, the dash's ending) is the one board hearth lamp. Never from a level-up card or the ember's cards; console grants (--dash-step) until then.
_kinds: charge (+amount pips, at most 2 from steps), length (the dash goes amount farther), recharge (charges come back amount sooner), landing (every dash ends in a shove). most: times it may be taken (1 if unset). lamp: the id the board lights (hard_landing only). from: where a step without a lamp is earned (story, gear). Loaded by logic/Content/DashSteps.cs; checked by tests/DashStepTests.cs.

steps.name: Another Breath
steps.card: One more dash before you must catch your breath.

steps.name: Hard Landing
steps.card: Every dash ends in a shove: lesser things within 2 m are knocked aside.
